spec: Product rail 256 to 288 wide on a 2 to 4% tinted shell, no border. Head: 32px logo tile, workspace name 14/500, 12px plan line, up-down chevron. Rows 32 tall with 4 gap, 16px icons, 14px labels, 12px muted group labels. Footer: avatar, name, email.

Docs or reference rail 240 to 288 wide: search field with shortcut chip on top, 12 to 13px muted group labels, 14/400 rows at 32 to 37 pitch, chevrons on groups, bottom scroll fade. Current row filled: 6px radius, 5 to 7% ink or pale accent, weight 500.

Dark rail 280 wide on near-black, 1px divider at 10% white, 64px brand head. 12px muted group labels, 14px rows in second ink at 33 pitch, 15px solid glyphs. Active row 6% white, 6px radius. Switcher pinned bottom behind a rule; list fades under it.

Settings or enterprise rail: 14px rows 32 tall, 6px radius, 6% grey fill on the current row plus a 3 to 4px accent bar outside or flush with the fill. 12/600 muted group labels, 1px dividers between groups. Holds dense admin screens with many sections.

Open group reveals children indented 16px beside a 1px vertical guide at 8 to 10% ink. Rows 28 to 32 tall, 13 to 14px, chevron rotates 90 degrees in 150ms. Only the current branch stays open. File trees add 16px icons and 16px per depth.

Text-only docs rail with no fills: 13 to 14/500 group heads in ink, 13 to 14/400 items in muted ink at 26 to 42 pitch, active shown by ink or accent text alone, 1px right rule optional. Lowest chrome of the set, for short docs.

48px icon rail, 16px glyphs in second ink, 6px radius hover chip, active 2px accent edge, labels in tooltips. Use beside a second contextual panel in tools, or as the collapsed state of a 256 rail with its toggle at the bottom.

Second-level nav beside content, 160 to 256 wide: 14px rows 32 to 36 tall with 16px outline icons, tinted current row at 6px radius, small footer actions. Lists filters, saved views or in-page sections and sits inside the page under global nav.

Rail panel 332 wide holding a 16/700 title and round add button, then 8px-radius prompt cards one tone step up with 14/700 title, one line and a white 32px pill. Legal and language pinned at the base. The rail teaches before it has content.

Right column 296 to 380 wide beside main content: 14/600 section heads, key-value rows 13 to 14px at 24 pitch, 12px topic chips, small sparkline with count, 1px dividers. Facts only, no actions beyond a link.

Editor side panel 215 to 280 wide: search on top, collapsible 11 to 12px bold sections, grid of 26px tool glyphs or 13px label plus checkbox rows at 22 pitch, pinned more button. Flat, 1px dividers, no shadows.

Full app table: 40px head on 4% ink fill, rows 48 to 53, 14px cells, 1px rules at 8% ink, checkbox and action columns, status badges, 3% hover fill, 12px radius wrapper. Tabs or toolbar above, selection count and page controls below.

Quiet table with no outer box: 44 to 53px rows, 14/400 cells, 13 to 14/500 header, 1px rules at 8 to 12% ink only, no zebra, no vertical rules, numerals right aligned and tabular, optional bold total row in the footer.

Dense numeric table without rules: 36 to 40px rows, 14/400, alternate rows at 2 to 3% ink with 4 to 6px radius, 12/500 muted headers, 16px favicon plus name, right-aligned tabular numbers, one active sort arrow.

Wide comparison table: two-tier head on a tinted fill, 12/600 group row over 12/600 column row with 11px unit lines, vertical 1px rules only between groups, rows 40 to 45, 12 to 13px, 4x16 entity colour tab before the name, centred tabular numerals.

Ranked list where each label sits on a tinted bar scaled to its value: 36px pitch, 32px bar, radius 4, 10% tint, value right aligned at 14/500 in its own column. Bars stop short of the values. One tint per panel.

Editorial list on a shared column grid: 53px rows, 1px rules, 11px mono caps headers or none, 13 to 14px cells, bold title, long text fading on a 40px mask rather than an ellipsis. Hover draws an 8px-radius band outdented 16px past the rules.

Comparison table: first column 240 wide, parent rows 57 tall at 15px, child rows 45 tall at 13px, muted and indented 16px. Yes is a 14px filled disc with white tick, no a 10px thin x. Recommended column holds a 2% tint.

Reference table in mono 13 to 14px: 37 to 44px rows, dashed or hairline separators, right-aligned numbers, final price column bold, repeated names blanked so instances read as groups. Props version: 1px border, 6px radius, 12px muted header, type chips.

Stacked reference: mono 14px bold name, 12px muted type beside it, description 14 to 16px below, 1px rules between, nested child-attributes toggle. Better than a table when descriptions run to sentences. Pair with a bordered summary card in the right column.

List rows instead of columns: 16 to 40px leading icon or thumbnail, 15 to 16/500 title with inline 12px pills, 12px muted meta line, trailing counts. 64 to 96px tall, rules inside one 6 to 8px box, or separate hairline cards 8 to 20px apart.

Two-column ranked list: rank numeral, 20px logo, 14/500 name, muted owner, right-aligned volume and 12px delta coloured by direction. Sorted descending, no headers. Use on overview pages where the rank is the message.

Definition list for one record: 88 to 120px muted label column, 14px values, 12px row gap, items centred; status as a soft 12/500 badge, IDs in mono with a copy icon, links in accent. Use on detail pages instead of a two-column table.

Row states: hover 3 to 4% ink fill at 150ms; selected pale accent fill with a 2px left edge; a contextual bar replaces the toolbar with a count, bulk actions and cancel, in one strong fill so the mode is obvious.

Rows that open in place: 32 to 40px, chevron at left rotating 90 degrees, detail inset on a 2 to 4% fill with key-value pairs, height eased 200ms. Folder version uses 16px icons, 16px indent per depth, trailing commit line and time.

Status pills 20 to 22 tall, 12/500, 6 to 8px padding, full or 6px radius: subtle tint with dark same-hue text, or hairline with a 7px dot. Optional 12px icon or spinner. Colour maps to state only and the text always names the state.

Table ending: left a selection count at 13px muted, right a rows-per-page select, page N of M and four 32px icon buttons; or a centred numbered pager with 32px squares, 6px radius, current page solid. Tabular numerals so width never jumps.

Long table or code truncated: last two rows fade to page colour across 80px, and a 32px hairline pill with chevron overlaps the fade at centre. Keeps docs pages short without pagination. Reveal in place and keep scroll position.

Bar above a list with every control 32px: search field grows, then labelled filters with bold value, sort select, list or table view toggle, count at right, 8px gaps. Active filters show as removable chips with a clear-all.

Overlapping 24 to 32px circles, -8px overlap, 2px ring in the surface colour, trailing +N count on 6% ink at 12/500. Letter fallback is 11px initials on grey. Status dot 10px at the corner with the same ring.

Shell at 2 to 4% tint, 256 rail, main as a white inset card: 8px margin, 12px radius, hairline. 48px header with sidebar toggle, title, actions. 24px padding, 16px gaps: four KPI tiles, one chart card, tabs, table.

Black shell, 8px gaps: 332 library panel, flexible main, thin right rail, each one tone step up with 8px radius. 64px top bar sits on the shell. Only panels scroll, so the frame never moves. Suits media and consumer apps.

One 1088px column on faint grey: filter row, full-width chart card with KPI tabs, then pairs of 534px tabbed cards, 20px gaps. White cards, radius 8, tiny shadow, no border. No sidebar, because the report is the app.

KPIs as the chart's tab bar: 6 equal cells inside the card, 12/500 caps label, 18 to 20/600 value, 12px delta with arrow, 1px dividers, active cell 3% fill at radius 8. Clicking swaps the series below.

Four equal tiles, 16 gap, 1px hairline, 12 radius, 20px padding: 13px muted label, 28 to 32/600 tabular value, 12px delta naming its comparison period. Arrow shows direction, colour shows good or bad. Never more than 4 across.

Single 640 to 720 column: logo and subscribe, tinted banner with a 1px status border stating the state, one bordered panel of services with 90-day strips, then incident history. No nav, no sidebar. Readable during an outage.
Tool frame filling the viewport: 48px icon rail, main work pane, 350px side panel, top bar, status bar, 1px dividers, no shadows, 12 to 13px type, tabs per document. Each pane scrolls alone.

Query above and result below, or input left and output right, inside a 12px-radius panel: 150px sub-nav, ghost toolbar for split, add, time range and refresh, stacked panes with their own titles. Preview and JSON tabs on output. Stack on phone.

Panes in a hairline 8px-radius frame split by 1px rules, optional 12x16 grip on the seam, hit area 8px wider than the line, minimum widths to stop collapse. Each list scrolls inside with a thin overlay thumb and keeps its position.

Bar 48 to 56 tall: sidebar toggle, 16px hairline divider, 14px breadcrumb with muted parents and 500 current, actions right. Dark version uses 48px square icon cells. Add a second tier of 14px tabs only when sections need it.
Section tabs 40px high, 14/500 with 16px padding, or 12/500 caps inside cards. Inactive second ink, active ink with a 2px underline sitting on the row's 1px rule, so nothing jumps. Disabled at 40%.

Card with a header grid: 16/600 title and 14px muted description left, ghost action top right, 24px internal spacing, footer rule; small size uses 16px padding. Media version bleeds a 16:9 image at top. For settings and detail groups.

Reports page of 2 or 3 column chart cards with hairline borders, 14px title, source badge, export and table icons top right, shared palette and scales. Title states the metric or finding, and card heights align per row.
Fixed docs shell: 220 to 300 left nav, 640 to 720 content, 200 right page index with active heading in ink, 64px sticky top bar, 1px rule beside nav. Right column may hold a small promo card.

Design system page: each demo in a 1px bordered well, 8 to 12px radius, centred control, 48px show-code footer strip; anatomy diagrams with numbered pins and leader lines; do and don't pairs with 4px green or red top bars.

Layout grid with 1px guide lines between cells, plus marks at intersections, 13px cell numbers top left, dashed version, solid cells that clip the guides. For docs and landing sections that want a visible engineering grid.

Grid of 190px tiles with a generated gradient per item, 12 to 16px radius, white 16/700 title, small status pill, author and count footer at 12px. Colour comes from the item, so scanning feels like browsing. Expressive, not for data.

One metric over time: 2px line with straight segments, fill from 14% accent to clear, 1px grid at 5 to 8% ink, 12px tabular y labels on a nice scale from 0, 5 to 7 x labels, crosshair and tooltip on hover, 240 to 340 tall.

Stat above a minimal plot: 11px caps label, 24/400 value, 1px line with 6% fill fading to surface, dashed reference line, right axis at 10px with the reference value brightened, no gridlines. On dark, a black panel at radius 24. Label the threshold.

Ninety daily bars per service: bar 5 to 6px wide, 2 to 3px gap, 14 to 34 tall, radius 1. One calm fill, amber and red for incident days, grey for no data. Name left, uptime percent right, 90 days ago and Today at the ends.

Weekly bars filling their bands with 2px gaps, radius 2, single hue, right axis 12px, title plus range subtitle. Thin 44px area brush below with the selected window tinted. Current incomplete period drawn in grey, never as a drop.

Grid of 2 to 3 columns of small chart cards, one entity each: name or avatar, total, mini bars in one hue. Every panel shares the same y max and x range, so heights compare directly. Labels only at month starts.

Weekly stacked bars, 1 to 2px surface gap between segments, 4 to 5 series then Other in grey, legend above, 12px axis, linear or log toggle top right. Partial current period hatched above its real value. Keep series order stable.

Two overlaid areas in one ink at 30 and 60% fill, thin line on top, range segmented control top right, 12px dates. Add a y axis with values, which the source omits. Use straight or monotone segments, because smooth splines invent peaks.

Lines labelled on the plot, no legend: filled 12/600 chips on 1px vertical leaders into each curve, single pale axes, 11px caps axis titles. Highlight series dashed in accent with an open-ring terminus and a bordered note. State when schematic.

Vertical bars sorted descending, one entity per bar, 16 to 24px thick, 4px gap, hairline grid, 45 degree labels with logo, value on the cap. Colour follows the owner, so the same owner keeps its colour. New items get a small tag.

Two-measure scatter: 8 to 10px dots coloured by owner, direct labels on notable points, shaded target quadrant, dotted frontier line, 11 to 12px axis titles with units, log axis stated in the title, frontier toggle, table view.

One ratio or under 6 shares: donut with 60% inner radius, 2px surface gaps, 32/300 total in the centre, legend with percentages at the side; or a 12px semicircle arc over a grey track. Use ranked bars when values are close.

Hover card: surface fill, 1px hairline, 8px radius, soft shadow; 12px rows with swatch, muted label and right-aligned tabular value, date heading at 500. Crosshair 1px at 18% ink, dots 8px with a 2px surface ring. Flip near the right edge.

Chart container: 16 to 20px padding, 14 to 16/600 title left, unit subtitle, three 16px toolbar icons right for table view, expand and more, legend of 8px squares below the plot, 1px grid, footnote with source. White on a tinted page.

Monitoring panel one step above near-black: 1px bright line, 1px grid at 6% white both ways, 12px muted axes, 14/500 title, segmented chart-type toggle at right with active in accent text. Dense and unsmoothed.

Progress against a limit: 4 to 8px track at 10% ink, full radius, ink or accent fill, 14/500 label left and tabular value right above it. Width animates 500ms. Fill shifts to amber then red past thresholds; hairline ticks mark stops.

Rank over time: smooth curves across 5 to 6 named columns, one highlighted in ink and the rest pale, rank labels at left, category pills above. Curves are safe here because only order matters. Say rank, not value.

Share by area: flat tiles with 4px radius and 2px gaps, solid fills, white 12/500 labels only where they fit, value in the tooltip, grouped by category colour. For many small parts where exact comparison matters less.

Map inside a tabbed card about 480 wide: sequential tints of one hue from 10 to 100%, thin surface borders, places without data stay neutral. Tabs switch to a ranked list, which carries the exact values.
Trend beside a row: 110x30 line or area in one hue, no axes, inside a table or meta rail next to a count and a period label. The number carries the scale and the sparkline carries only the shape.

Label 13/500 above, 6px gap, input 36 to 40 tall, 6 to 8px radius, 1px inset line at 18% ink, 14px text, third-ink placeholder, 12px helper below. Focus: accent line plus 3px ring at 24%. 16 to 24px between fields.

Prefix, suffix and actions inside one 36px border: $ or icon at 12px inset, muted unit, trailing 28px ghost button, or tinted scheme addon with a divider. Focus ring wraps the whole group, never the inner input. Textarea adds a 12px footer line.

Enterprise field: 40px tall, 3 to 4% grey fill on white, 0 radius, 1px bottom border only, 12px label above, 12px helper below. Focus swaps to a 2px accent inset outline. Forms stack at 24px rhythm with square 48px buttons.

No box: one 1px ink or grey bottom rule, 12px label above or 18px placeholder, optional icon, 60px tall in hero search. Focus thickens the rule or shows a small cursor mark. For editorial and agency forms, never dense admin.

Two columns: 14/600 labels in a 190px column, 336px inputs at 44 to 48 tall, 1px border, 4px radius, focus 2px accent with a faint halo. Reads as a contract. Suits contact sales and long account forms on wide screens.

Dense tool form: mono parameter name plus type tag, 12px default hint below, or a 12/600 label cell on a one-step fill joined to a 32px input, 4px radius, two-up grid. Sliders pair with a number box showing min and max.

Invalid: 1px danger border plus 3px ring at 16%, 12 to 13px danger message with a 14px circled icon 6px below, replacing the helper. Validate on blur or submit, not while typing. Disabled is 4% fill and third ink with layout unchanged.

Track 32 to 48 tall, 6 to 14px radius, 4 to 7% ink fill, 3 to 4px inset; active chip in surface colour with hairline and 1px shadow, inactive second ink, no dividers. Equal widths to the longest label. Labels may carry a small saving chip.

White track with 1px hairline, 6px radius, 4px padding, 34 to 42 tall; active item 5 to 7% grey fill in ink, inactive second ink, no shadow. Full-width and icon-only forms with tooltips. The compact three-state theme switch lives here.

Page-level choice: 415x54 full-pill track at 7% ink, half-width thumb in solid ink with inverted 16/600 label, inactive 40% grey. Bigger than usual so it reads as scoping the page. Two or three options.

Attached items sharing one seam: 32 to 36 tall, 8 to 10px outer radius, square inner corners, 1px divider, active solid ink or 7% fill. Covers filter bars, split buttons and toolbars. Fit 2 to 5 items; icons 16px in 32px squares.

Track 28x16 to 44x24, full pill, accent when on, 7% ink off, white circular thumb with 1px ring, 140ms ease. Label sits 8px away and aligns to its first text line. A switch acts at once; use checkboxes in saved forms.

Settings card: 14/600 row title and 12px muted copy left, stacked 28x16 switches with 12/500 channel labels right, 1px dividers, 100 to 110px pitch, 24px card padding. Shows several decisions per row without a table.

Whole tile is the target: 70px tall, 6 to 12px radius, 1px hairline, 14/500 title, muted second line, 16px radio or checkbox at right. Selected: 1px accent edge, 7% accent fill, tinted text, filled dot. Hover 4% ink. 12px gaps.

16px box at 4px radius or circle, 1px line at 18% ink, checked solid ink with white tick or 8px dot, 14/500 label, 14px muted description, 8 to 12px gap, 12px between options. Focus ring outlines the box.
Row of 28 to 40 tall filters: active solid ink or 8% fill, others bare or hairline, 12 to 14px, count at right. Two taxonomies can use two chip styles. Scrolls sideways on phone with no wrap.

AI input as the page's centre: 640 wide, 20px radius, 1px line at 18% ink, 16px placeholder, foot row with add button, 32px mode segment, model select, mic and 32px solid send disc. Grows to 40vh; focus darkens the edge.

Composer pinned to the viewport base over docs: 576x62, 16px radius, 1px line, 15px placeholder, shortcut hint, 24px circular send. Article scrolls behind it, full width on phone. A flush square dock with blur suits fashion search.
Track 4 to 6px, full radius, 8 to 10% ink, range in ink or accent, 16px white thumb with 1px edge and small shadow. Label left, tabular value right, number box for exact entry. Range uses two thumbs.

Cost calculator: numbered steps, 36px tall radius 8 block slider filled solid ink to a thin grab bar with the value beside it, or a select that changes the price in place, estimate rail at right with boxed mono tags and right-aligned totals.

Trigger 36 tall with calendar icon and date or range; popover month grid of 32px cells, 14/400 numerals, selected solid ink at 8px radius, range as a 6% band with solid caps, muted outside days, ghost chevrons, presets at left.

Card 384 wide on a 4% tint, 14px radius, hairline, 24px padding: logo above, 20/600 title, muted line, 36px outline SSO buttons, or-rule, labelled 36px inputs, forgot link on the label row, solid 36px submit, 12px legal below.

Two columns: left an email and password stack at 36px with an outline SSO button, right a full-height image or product panel at 10px radius. Same control sizes as the rest of the app. Drop the panel on phone.

Six 36 to 44px square slots joined as one group, 1px hairline, 8px outer radius, centred tabular digits, active slot 2px ring, dash between groups of three. Paste fills all slots; submit on the last digit.

Read view is plain 14px text in a 32px row with 4% hover fill; click swaps to a bordered input with 24px confirm and cancel icon buttons floating bottom right. Esc cancels, Enter saves, errors replace helper text.

App button ladder 24, 32, 40: 14/500, 6 to 8px radius, primary solid ink or accent, secondary hairline, tertiary text, danger red. Loading keeps width and swaps the icon for a spinner. Cancel left of primary, 8px gap, right aligned.

Inline feedback: a 13px one-line question with four 20px faces in a 40px hairline pill or two 24px thumbs; a reaction reveals a textarea and a send button that stays disabled until input. Sits at page end.

Centred stack in a bordered 8 to 12 radius box, 48 to 64px padding: 54px hairline icon tile or 24 to 32px glyph, 16 to 20/500 title, 14px muted copy at 40ch, one action, optional link. No illustration, no fill.

Centred: 80 to 160px brand illustration, 20/600 title, 14px muted copy at 400px, 32px primary, secondary beside it, tertiary link. For first-run and permission errors in products with a real illustration system.
Left aligned on the page grid: 40/600 plain statement, 17px line, two equal 56px buttons 360 wide, 12px radius, 15px gap, hairline then a help line, promo tile below. The page stays a page.

Turns a dead end into navigation: 20 to 24/300 sentence, small caps label, stack of 66px bordered rows with thumbnail and name, 16px gaps, sticky full-width button at the sheet base, warm scrim behind.
Brand voice does the work: 40px display line in the site's own face, short friendly sub line, one pill or 34px button, about 48px gaps, no icon. For consumer carts and brand pages.
Keep the structure and fill one line: a table keeps its header and shows a centred 14/500 title with one 14px line and text link; rail groups show a half-alpha empty line. No icon, no card.
Blank work pane teaches the keyboard: 3 to 4 rows with label right aligned at 12 to 13px muted and keycaps left, then one outlined docs link. Centred, no headline. Tools only.

Nothing wrong is a result: tinted banner with a 1px status border, 16px check disc, 15 to 16/500 statement, white body line; or a card with a 24px check and 20/600 title. State carried by tint and words.

Placeholders that match the final layout cell for cell: flat 7% ink blocks, 6px radius, widths varied 40 to 80%, real headers kept, pulse to 50% over 1.6s, none under reduced motion. Layout must not shift when data lands.

Short waits stay in place: 16px ring or spoke spinner, verb label 14/500, tabular amount right, 48px hairline row; inside buttons the spinner replaces the icon and width holds. Respect reduced motion.

Inline note: 36px minimum, 6 to 8px radius, 16px icon, 14px text in dark same-hue ink on an 8 to 14% tint, never saturated; optional 14/600 title and trailing 28px action. Hairline version for neutral info.

Modal 640 wide at 18vh, 12px radius, hairline plus deep shadow, light scrim. Input 52 tall with 16px text, 12px group labels, 40px rows with 16px icon and right keycaps, 8px radius active fill, footer with result count and Enter action.
Same list embedded: 260 to 400 wide in a hairline 12px card, 32px grey search field inset 8px, 12px group labels, 32px rows with active fill, shortcuts right. For pickers and blank pages.

Search field that teaches its shortcut: 32 to 50 tall, 1px line or 3% fill, 6 to 12px radius, 14 to 15px grey label, two 18 to 20px keycaps inset right. Opens the palette. Swap the chip for Esc once dirty.

Menu 200 to 256 wide, 8px radius, hairline, soft shadow, 4px padding. Items 32 tall, 14px, 6px radius hover fill, 16px icon, right mono shortcut in third ink. 12/500 label, 1px separators at -4px margin. Destructive last in danger ink.
Same menu at the cursor on right click, with submenus, checkbox and radio items, opening in under 100ms. Mirror every item in a visible overflow button, because right click cannot be discovered.

Field 36 to 40 tall with magnifier and up-down chevron, popover matching its width, 32 to 36px options, 16px accent check at right, 11px group headers, empty message. Multi version shows 24px chips with an x inside the field.
Keycaps 20 tall, 11/500 mono, 5 to 6px padding, 4px radius, 6% ink fill or 1px line, no bevel, 3px apart. Use real glyphs for command, shift and return. Show Ctrl on Windows.

Centred 450 to 512 wide, 12px radius, hairline, deep soft shadow, scrim 40% ink. 18/600 title, 14px description, 20px padding, 36px fields at 16px gaps, footer rule, Cancel then primary right aligned. Focus first field, Esc closes.

Destructive confirm, 420 wide: 18/600 title naming the object, one sentence with the consequence, footer right with a soft fill keep button then a solid danger verb button. Focus lands on the safe action. No dismiss on outside click.

Drill-down table over the dashboard: 885 wide, 12px radius, 48px from viewport edges, 18/600 title with a 256px search naming the / shortcut, sticky header, zebra 36px rows, body clipped mid-row to show it scrolls, load more at the end.

Consumer notice: 393 wide, 32px radius, warm off-white, 40% scrim, 88px 3D object, 24/600 centred two-line statement, 48px full-width solid button inset 24px, small x. One fact, one action, shown once.

Commerce capture: 520 to 800 wide, photo half, logo, 32 to 48px offer line, one email field, solid button, quiet decline link, 40 to 50% scrim. Delay it past first scroll. Declining must be as easy as accepting.

Right panel 400 to 480 wide, full height, scrim 30 to 40%, 48px header with title and x, scrolling body, sticky footer action, slides in 240ms ease-out. Keeps list context. For record detail, carts and filters.
Phone sheet from the base: full width, 16px top radius, 32x4 grab handle, title, one primary and Cancel, max 90dvh, drag to dismiss. Centred dialogs should become this under 600px.

Bottom right, 356 wide, 10px radius, hairline, soft shadow, 13/500 title, 13px muted line, 16px status icon, optional 24px Undo. Stacks peek 12px at scale .95. Auto-dismiss at 4 to 6s, pause on hover, errors persist.

Near-black chip on light themes, 12/500, 6 by 10px padding, 6px radius, 8px rotated arrow, 4px off the trigger, 150ms fade with 2px slide, 300ms delay. One short phrase, no actions. Keyboard focus shows it too.

Card attached to its trigger: 256 to 300 wide, 10px radius, hairline, two-layer soft shadow, 16px padding, 8px offset, flips at viewport edges, 150ms fade and 4px slide. Hover cards wait 200ms. Holds detail, never a form flow.

Fixed bottom-right card 344 to 390 wide, 4 to 12px radius, 16px bold title, short plain copy, close x, decline and accept equally visible. Personality allowed, such as a cut-out figure breaking the corner. Never blocks the page.

Two equal actions and no default bias: 414x170, compact title, one line of explanation, two 48px keys side by side, either answer continues. For permissions such as sound or motion on entry. Focus ring on the first.
